## Problem and change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any public contract changes. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Explain any relevant checks you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression coverage where behavior changed.
- [ ] Public documentation and CHANGELOG.md are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Historical evidence and original measurements remain unchanged.
- [ ] Shared fixtures, logs and evidence contain no secrets or private application data.
